name: Dalmia Bharat Sugar & Industries Ltd
about: Dalmia Bharat Sugar & Industries is mainly engaged in manufacturing of sugar, generation of power, manufacturing of Industrial alcohol and manufacturing of refractory products.[1]The company is among the youngest and largest sugar companies in India. Its is the fastest-growing sugar company with its presence in UP and Maharashtra.
keyPoints:
Revenue Mix FY23
Sugar - 67%
Distillery - 23%
History**[1]
DBSIL, a part of the Dalmia Bharat Group is a leading Indian sugar producer. In 1994, Company entered the sugarindustry by establishing 2500 TCD capacity sugar mill in UP.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.78 times its book value
cons: Company has a low return on equity of 10.3% over last 3 years.
Dividend payout has been low at 13.4% of profits over last 3 years
